/// One command-trace row, kept as values; the receipt's JSON is built from it on the heartbeat.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct TraceRow {
    game_frame: u64,
    status: i32,
    prev0: i32,
    events: pilot_core::move_observer::Events,
    phase: pilot_core::Phase,
    output: pilot_core::Output,
    p1_damage: f32,
    cpu_damage: f32,
}
impl TraceRow {
    fn value(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        let events = self.events;
        json!({"game_frame":self.game_frame,"status":self.status,
            "prev0":self.prev0,
            "active_family":events.active_family.map(|f| format!("{f:?}")),
            "completed":events.completed.map(|f| format!("{f:?}")),
            "interrupted":events.interrupted.map(|f| format!("{f:?}")),
            "phase":format!("{:?}",self.phase),
            "output":format!("{:?}",self.output),"p1_damage":self.p1_damage,"cpu_damage":self.cpu_damage})
    }
}

p23/rc6-cov-rest #58 (Eden covrest-08, 2026-11-08): purpose_view's F9 seat branch made a Want with no configuration when the plan did not list the seat's kind, so the CPU rotation's Mii Gunner was installed on entry 2 as a plain fighter; once No. of CPUs rose to 2 the game read null every frame (Unmapped Read64 @ 0x0, main+0x357bf34). The branch now loads what f9_gate armed (override_seat): the kind with the member's own exact-Mii configuration, through the Mii helper; f9_gate arms no Mii seat without one (parked_entries::seat_load).

p23/rc6-cov-rest #58, the first raise (reading A, primary 2026-11-08 16:04Z; DECISIONS F9 / HOT-SLOTS-CEILING "F9's fixed seats keep 2 and 3 for the next CPUs"): purpose_view's seat branch loaded a member on entry 2/3 only when the merged plan listed it with no configuration, and the body bank covered Donkey Kong, so the first raise after a scene start showed copies of CPU 1 (Eden covrest-07/08/09). A parked, unborrowed seat now holds its member (kind and exact-Mii configuration, parked_entries::parked_seat) whether or not the plan lists it; the load is the same speculative helper load, so process memory admission still holds it ("stays planned") when headroom refuses.

p23/rc6-cov-rest F9 x Mii, reading B (primary 2026-11-08 16:44Z; Eden covrest-11 [MiiHelperProof] refused id=2 why=mii record, recorded Proof == now): a seat the game activated as CPU 2 or 3 and parked again kept its identity but not its Mii record bytes, so both Mii owners refused every snapshot and the Mii classes left both cycles. F9 marks a published seat (f9_publish, f9_gate::mark_promoted); once it is parked again and parked ready, f9_reproof asks mii_managed_helper::reproof_parked to take its Mii proof (record and descriptor) again from the row, only when the identity is unchanged (the same ready source and configuration, binding, owner objects and scalars, the charinfo and a resource pair; parked_entries::reproof).

p23/rc6-cov-rest portrait race (primary 2026-11-08 17:28Z, readings A and B; Eden covrest-12): the CPU's next press was submitted in the frame the CPU's HUD portrait render was issued on helper 2 (the F9 seat holding the same exact Mii); its snapshot refused the row mid-render and the portrait's after-render proof quarantined helper 2 for the scene, so presses 1-5 loaded nothing. A: a Mii owner's begin (CPU begin_blocker, Player permitted) waits while that role's portrait job holds a helper lease or has its render issued (Blocker::Portrait, mii_hud_portrait::render_holds_helper); the press runs after the render, never dropped. B: the F9 seat branch of purpose_view starts no seat load while a portrait job wants a helper or holds one (portrait_waits, parked_entries::seat_load_waits), so the render is not pushed behind the seat's INSTALL.
